microscopic_law: 8 spinful matter sites,24 distinct positive-axis oriented torus links. H=HE+HU+sum(T+Tdag); HE=sum E²/32, HU=2sum(n-1)²=4D at N8, T=-sum_spin c_b† U_e c_a. E=-1,0,1, U unit step with zero at cap. No B term.
geometry: Vertex coordinates0/1 in each axis. Every vertex owns one outgoing link per axis; wrapping positive-axis arcs have length+1 on the cover, NOT displacement-1. Opposite arcs of an L2 axis are distinct links, not collapsed edges. Incidence source+1,target-1, rank7, cycle dimension24-8+1=17.
symmetry: G=B E+n-1. Every seed has G0; closed flux loops have B E0. Every full CAR hop raises/lowers its corresponding link in concert with both occupations, preserving all8 G exactly. The selected determinant projector is diagonal in these G, so PHP preserves exact Gauss. No encoded integer charge is used as parity.
safe_integer_lead_proof: If encoded sum_v G_v32^v=0 and actual |G_v|<=7 (six links plus n-1), reduce mod32: G0 must0, divide32 and induct. Thus zero encoded Gauss iff every G=0. For difference of allowed local charges, bounds<=14 still<32. This arithmetic does not assign CAR grading; even encoded charge can correspond to odd actual occupation. Our implementation uses independent real orbital-bit Jordan-Wigner signs instead.
fermions: Orbitals ordered site0up,site0down,...,site7down. To apply c_q†c_p, annihilation parity counts occupied lower orbitals in original bits and creation parity counts them after annihilation. Wrapped torus hopping keeps this same ordering/string. Full matter occupations0/up/down/double remain permitted at every site; link±1 remain permitted everywhere.
correlated_state: Selected-configuration interaction (comparable correlated variational state, not an invented tensor engine): psi=sum_C a_C |Fock_C> tensor |E_C>. Local factors remain4/3 dimensional. State1 all70 singly occupied Sz0 determinants and their primitive one-hop targets (1030 states). Materially different state2 adds all distinct elementary closed two-link winding and four-link plaquette flux seeds in both orientations, tensors with all70 matter seeds, then full one-hop dressing (69430 states). Their severe one-pair/full-H-variance limitation prompted an actually executed material third construction: all configurations within four primitive hops of every70 spin seed UNION the entire loop-dressed span (477302 states). It supports simultaneous0..4 holon/doublon pairs; observed probabilities are explicitly retained. All coefficients solved jointly by sparse projected-H eigensolver with independent fixed random initialization. This is a global variational correlation restriction, never full-H exact ED or frozen matter.
library: Existing numpy/scipy sparse matrices and eigsh. A full spinful two-site one-link Gauss Hamiltonian is actually diagonalized before periodic calculation and matched to analytic singlet energy. No dependency installs or runtime downgrades. Prefer existing library rather than build a generic TN framework; this candidate intentionally uses the contract-permitted comparable correlated-state route.
entanglement: Amplitudes are reshaped as sparse A_matter,field; purity=Tr[(A A†)²], S2=-ln(purity). This measures genuine quantum matter/field correlation, not classical field-only mean-field stiffness.
momentum: q=(pi,0,0) and(pi,pi,0) with real Hermitian self-inverse-q quadratures. Site phase=(-1)^(q_bits dot r); source link coefficients phase_at_source*p_axis/sqrt8. Discrete divergence vector d=2q_bits; p_T1,p_T2 form its actual nullspace, p_L=d/|d|. Exact Gauss:rho(q)=-16|d| F_L(q). This is a periodic lattice constraint, not a supplied photon dispersion. Link-centred complex phases are optional rephasings; all executed operators use the stated real source-origin convention.
observables: F=E/16. Jflux=-i(T-T†)=i[H,E], jQ=-Jflux. Signed primitive current is built independently from every selected full hopping matrix element and compared with -16i[PHP,F] on the projected reference. K_ab=-sum_e coeff_ae coeff_be <T_e+T_e†> is the signed twist contact. Contact belongs to current-versus-vector-potential response, not a fictitious F-F diamagnetic term.
response: The actual coupled F_T1,F_T2,F_L,jQ_T1,jQ_T2,jQ_L,rho source Gram and spectral amplitudes are retained. Block-Krylov uses all independent field columns and their repeated own-PHP action; currents are independently checked primitive identities. Every near-degenerate Ritz group retains its complete source weight matrix/rank, never one named polarization vector. Positive/negative-frequency retarded denominators are both retained; chi_ab(z)=sum_m[V_ma*V_mb/(z-Delta_m)-V_mb*V_ma/(z+Delta_m)]. These full joint susceptibilities are reducible and never Dyson irreducible inputs.
reference_uncertainty: Each ansatz independently solves its own PHP stationary reference. Finite-depth block Ritz poles are spectral quadrature, with selected-space residuals, NOT exact full-H Lehmann modes. Exact full-H external residual is separately computed by accumulating every Q H psi amplitude with coherent CAR signs, Q=1-P; add its norm squared to projected residual squared for the true full-H energy variance. Omitted_hop_probability_sum only detects leakage opportunity and is NOT that variance. Actual state comparison changed the physical decision and triggered the multi-pair construction, rather than refining a bound. Large full-H residual defeats exact-photon promotion even when selected-space ground residual is small.
off_control: Own-H hoppingOFF is diagonal HE+HU, so[E,Hoff]=0 as an exact full local-space operator identity. Same correlated state, bra, baseline and E-inserted vector are all propagated by Hoff; signed E-E retarded response vanishes. This is not defined by deleting a J insertion. The control can defeat field response but does not prove two radiation branches.
limits: One L2 torus contains no low-q limit and is not massless/thermodynamic/Coulomb/Nature proof. Variational short-range/loop-selected basis may distort collective weight or gaps, and finite-depth quadrature is not eigenmode convergence. No physical Noether spin, electron/proton or issue-closure claim; distinct from local-rich-frame law.
